      Mac Studio M5 Max, M5 Ultra Prices

      Disclosure: If you buy through our links, we may earn commission as an affiliate & Amazon Associate.

      Apple's 2026 Mac Studio was announced on August 25th, with an upgrade to the M5 Max or M5 Ultra chip. Both chip options have Neural Accelerators in each GPU core, and the M5 Ultra is Apple's most powerful chip ever with the company's first quad-die architecture.

      The powerful desktop can be configured with up to 512GB of RAM (that option is available in October 2026) and up to 16TB of storage. Prices across the line start at $2,499, but expect to find Mac Studio deals from Apple resellers in this Price Guide.
